critical_code_review_comments: routers/chat.py audit chain: SHA256(canonical_json({prev,id,at,account_id,chat_id,action,payload,ip,ua_sha})) verified by recomputing rows 2..N in the test — every hash matches and prev_hash links to the previous row's row_hash. Genesis constant 'GENESIS-AKKI-CHAT-AUDIT-2026' applied to first-ever row only.

routers/chat.py policy=off footgun guard: when has_identifiers and not acknowledge_unshielded → 409 with detail.code='shielding_acknowledgement_required'. Acknowledged path persists bypass_reason='policy_off_acknowledged' on both the message and the audit row — verified.

routers/chat.py auto policy: identifiers detected → will_shield=True, identifiers_masked counted, by_category split (email + phone) — verified live with 'x@y.com / +254712345678' yielding identifiers_masked=2.

routers/chat.py list_chats fallback sort: re-sorts in Python by (last_message_at OR created_at) desc so freshly-created empty chats sit at the top — verified by creating two empty chats in sequence and asserting the newer id ranks above the older.
routers/chat.py cross-account: GET/PATCH/DELETE/audit on a Bramuel-owned chat from admin all return 404 — no cross-tenant leakage.

routers/chat.py multi-turn shielded: 'My name is Bramuel.' shielded as [PERSON_1] in transit; the next turn 'What is my name?' rehydrated correctly to 'Bramuel' in the assistant reply — confirms the manual replay loop preserves conversational reference even with shielding active.

AuthContext.jsx afterAuth persist: data.access_token written to localStorage('akki_access_token'); subsequent /auth/me uses Bearer interceptor. Bootstrap clears stale token on /auth/me failure so a poisoned token can't loop the user. Verified by post-login localStorage read (len=244).
